# ToolSnap plugin for Antigravity

Deterministic web and document extraction for [Google Antigravity](https://antigravity.google)
(Antigravity CLI `agy`, Antigravity IDE, Antigravity 2.0), via the
[ToolSnap](https://toolsnap.app) MCP server — exact parsing instead of loading
raw pages into context (median ~98% fewer tokens than raw HTML).

## Install

```bash
git clone https://github.com/ToolSnap-app/toolsnap-antigravity-plugin ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/plugins/toolsnap
agy plugin install ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/plugins/toolsnap
```

ToolSnap is a remote MCP server (streamable HTTP) on Cloudflare — nothing runs
locally, and the free tools need no account or API key.

Migrating from Gemini CLI and already had the
[ToolSnap Gemini CLI extension](https://github.com/ToolSnap-app/toolsnap-gemini-extension)
installed? Antigravity's first-launch onboarding auto-converts it to this same
plugin shape — no separate install needed.

## What you get

- `fetch_extract` — a page's text, exact and clean, at a fraction of the tokens.
- `fetch_html` — clean DOM for rebuilding or migrating a page.
- `csv_query` / `json_query` — query a large dataset server-side; only matching rows return.
- `pdf_text_extract`, `rss_parse`, `sitemap_parse`, `fetch_metadata`, and more.

Most of the catalog is free. Discover everything with `tool_catalog`.

## Paid tools (optional)

`screenshot_url`, `keyword_research`, `remove_background` and `fetch_rendered`
settle per call ($0.02–$0.04). Buy fiat credits at
<https://mcp.toolsnap.app/checkout>, then add your key to `mcp_config.json` in
this plugin's directory:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "toolsnap": {
      "serverUrl": "https://mcp.toolsnap.app/mcp",
      "headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer sk_live_..." }
    }
  }
}
```

For x402 (USDC on Base), point `command`/`args` at the local
[pay-proxy](https://github.com/icosaedro-git/toolsnap-mcp#paid-tools--connect-through-the-pay-proxy)
instead of `serverUrl`.

## Links

- ToolSnap docs: <https://mcp.toolsnap.app/docs>
- ToolSnap server (source): <https://github.com/icosaedro-git/toolsnap-mcp>

MIT licensed.
